deviations.what: before t6, fold scripts/firmware-release.py into the xteink CLI as 'xteink firmware release <pr>' and 'xteink firmware report-rollbacks', delete the script; t6 ships fork PR #4 with 'xteink firmware release 4' instead of the script
deviations.reason: CLAUDE.md requires product components under a CLI noun group, not a separate entry point; the script (ac1515c, OTA plan) broke that rule and the user asked for it to be part of the CLI

evidence.behavior_text: the tick decision redraws once on a minute change, never on an unchanged minute, and not on the first reading
evidence.contract_text: exactly one requestUpdate per local-minute change; none while the minute is unchanged across the 10-50 ms loop iterations
evidence.strength_basis: fork host tests (ctest, test/), built from xteink-firmware 498dc69d, tree-identical to the merge 2b3cbdea; ran green. Covers the pure decision function only; the HomeActivity::pollClockTick -> requestUpdate wiring is not host-tested

evidence.behavior_text: before the install the header clock stayed stale without a key press; after it, the Home clock changed on its own
evidence.contract_text: exactly one requestUpdate per local-minute change; none while the minute is unchanged across the 10-50 ms loop iterations
evidence.strength_basis: the owner reported 'bug confirmed, fix confirmed' on the real device; the tick count and timing were not measured (no serial log)

evidence.behavior_text: ticks 15 and 30 decide HALF, ticks 14 and 16 FAST, and the count restarts on Home re-entry
evidence.contract_text: the 15th, 30th, ... minute tick since Home was entered renders with HALF_REFRESH; every other tick with FAST_REFRESH; the count restarts on Home re-entry
evidence.strength_basis: fork host tests (ctest, test/), built from xteink-firmware 498dc69d, tree-identical to the merge 2b3cbdea; ran green. Decision function only; the render() refresh-mode wiring and the on-device HALF were not observed

evidence.behavior_text: the routine writes the RTC through the port only after SNTP answered, with the SNTP epoch, and never from a fast RTC or an implausible clock
evidence.contract_text: writes the RTC and refreshes the cache from a UTC epoch without calling setenv/tzset/configTzTime; called only from the routine's task, only after SNTP reports COMPLETED
evidence.strength_basis: fork host tests (ctest, test/), built from xteink-firmware 498dc69d, tree-identical to the merge 2b3cbdea; ran green against a fake port. The TZ-free HalClock::setUtc itself is not host-tested (no setenv/tzset assertion); that part rests on code review

evidence.behavior_text: an unanswered SNTP is waited for at most min(8 s, remaining cap); success writes the RTC; a timeout leaves the RTC and the run outcome unchanged
evidence.contract_text: if SNTP has not completed, waits at most min(8 s, remaining cap) for it; on success writes the RTC, on timeout leaves the RTC untouched and the run's outcome unchanged
evidence.strength_basis: fork host tests (ctest, test/), built from xteink-firmware 498dc69d, tree-identical to the merge 2b3cbdea; ran green against a fake port. On-device (t8, rtc_written yes after a real 06:00 run) is still pending

evidence.test_ref: pio run -e default and -e x4pro at 498dc69d (static_assert on JERUSALEM_INDEX in src/util/Timezones.cpp)
evidence.behavior_text: both envs build; the Jerusalem default index is checked at compile time
evidence.contract_text: with the xteink flag: clockShowInHeader defaults 1 and the clock TZ defaults Asia/Jerusalem when none is chosen; without the flag both defaults are unchanged; saved settings always win
evidence.strength_basis: a build check only: no test asserts clockShowInHeader=1 on a fresh device, the non-flag defaults, or saved-settings precedence (plan risk r1: not proven on a wiped device)

evidence.behavior_text: the decision is a constexpr function of (state, minuteKey) that builds and runs on the host with no HAL or Arduino headers
evidence.contract_text: deterministic, no HAL or Arduino dependency, returns {redraw, refreshMode} from (lastMinute, nowMinute, tickCount); each tick logs one line with minute and FAST/HALF
evidence.strength_basis: fork host tests (ctest, test/), built from xteink-firmware 498dc69d, tree-identical to the merge 2b3cbdea; ran green. The one-log-line-per-tick part is in HomeActivity (LOG_INF) and is not asserted by a test

deltas.behavior_text: the agent release flow is the CLI verb 'xteink firmware release PR' (plus 'report-rollbacks'); scripts/firmware-release.py is removed. Same checks and flags; refusals exit 1, tool failures exit 2 through CliError. tests/test_firmware_release.py (17) drives the CLI; first live run shipped fork PR #4 as 1.6.5+xteink.2b3cbdea

TrustedTime::syncNow keeps its own COMPLETED reading (ESP-IDF clears the status on read), so a successful SNTP sync is no longer reported as failed; a pre-existing bug in the released c6e8b2cf build, found in /code-review; test/test_trusted_time.py's stub now clears on read

when SNTP already answered this boot (e.g. the post-OTA health check), the routine uses the system clock as network time instead of adopting a possibly fast RTC; a contradictory implausible answer blocks the RTC write for that run
the Home tick polls the clock once a second (not every loop iteration) and is skipped when the theme's header shows no clock (metrics.headerShowsClock)

review hardening of 'xteink firmware release' (#6 /code-review rounds): an error after the upload exits 2 naming the failed step instead of the catch-all exit 1; a tool that cannot start exits 2; the xteink calls run this same install (python -m xteink); a dedupe onto another commit's upload refuses before offering and names the offer command; report-rollbacks split per image. tests/test_firmware_release.py: 25 passed at main d56e0d8 (2026-10-12T21:50Z)
